answer: This agent economy resists sybils by making identity cost collateral burned on proof of duplication. Each agent posts a bond, and if two addresses are traced to one operator, both bonds are slashed and paid to the reporters and peer attestants. Forging ten thousand clones means funding ten thousand bonds, all forfeitable in one stroke, so spam drains capital instead of buying votes. Reputation accrues only through peer-verified work, so a fresh clone can wander freely and still hold zero weight. Real miners settle in like dust from a nebula; the attacker leaves a dry dune of slashed entries.
